name: handoff-tool
description: Plan-execute handoff tool — allows the agent to clear context and restart with a prepared plan

enabled.description: Whether this extension is enabled. Set to false to disable the extension entirely.

systemPrompt.description: Whether to include handoff tool instructions in the system prompt.

autoIncludeFilesUnderBytes.description: Files in the handoff files list that exist and are this size or smaller (in bytes) are inlined into the handoff message automatically; larger and missing files are listed with their size. Default 24KB. Set to 0 to list files without inlining any.
